card.name: Words just before infection or leukemia names
card.fires_on: Short words or word starts like non, mild, or, of, for that sit right before the name of an infection or blood cancer in dosing and warning headings. The next word is usually a disease term such as non-gonococcal, influenza, or leprosy.

modes.label: Non before disease
modes.description: The word non or non- opens a negated disease term.
modes.example: Genital ulcer disease (chancroid)<< Non>>-gonococcal urethritis and

modes.label: Linking word in a heading
modes.description: A small word such as for, of, or, or an open bracket comes before an infection name in a dosing heading.
modes.example: Dosage for Prophylaxis and Treatment<< of>> Uncomplicated Influenza A

modes.label: Start of a severity or type word
modes.description: The first letter or syllable of a word like mild or influenza.

card.plain: It fires on the small word right before a named infection or leukemia type in dosing sections.
